 Watch Carter Faith Perform New Song 'Still The Sparrow Sings' At The Bluebird Cafe
 10-30-2026 
 (Sacks & Co) Breakout star Carter Faith shares a new song, "Still the Sparrow Sings," along with a performance video filmed at Nashville's The Bluebird Cafe. Written and performed by Faith for Netflix's upcoming original movie, Heartland, the track is the second release from the film's official soundtrack, out November 13. Heartland marks Faith's acting debut alongside Academy Award-winner Jessica Chastain and premieres exclusively on Netflix on November 13 (watch the trailer HERE). The film follows Faith's first-ever CMA Award nomination for New Artist of the Year, which will be presented live on ABC on Wednesday, November 18 at 8:00pm ET. An acclaimed live performer, Faith joined Chris Stapleton, Kacey Musgraves and Shaboozey on tour this fall and is currently out on her own Cherry Valley Forever Tour, which includes stops at San Diego's House of Blues, Saint Louis' Old Rock House and Chicago's Joe's on Weed Street, among others. See below for complete tour routing. The new dates follow the release of Cherry Valley Forever, the deluxe edition of Faith's acclaimed debut album Cherry Valley. Released this summer, the expanded project adds five new tracks to the original record, including "Nothin' Better To Do" with Wyatt Flores and "Pearl Handled Pistol" with Laci Kaye Booth and Baby Nova. The deluxe arrived on the heels of Faith's historic ACM Album of the Year nomination for Cherry Valley-the first debut album to earn a nod in the category in a decade, following Chris Stapleton's Traveller in 2016. Cherry Valley is one of the most-lauded country debuts in recent memory: Rolling Stone named it their #1 country album of the year and #17 on their Best 100 Albums of 2025 alongside accolades from Billboard, Stereogum, NPR Music, The Hollywood Reporter and many more.
